payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the system significantly improved the precision and reduced false positives in information extraction compared to a mature system.

claims.text: The system led to large improvements over a mature and highly tuned constraint-based production information extraction system used at Bloomberg.
The architecture resulted in substantial improvements over a mature and highly tuned constraint-based information extraction system for financial language text.
In a production setting, the neural architecture reduced the number of false positive extractions relative to a mature system developed over several years.
The full pipeline resulted in a reduction in false positives of more than INLINEFORM0 in the extractions produced by our pipeline.
